words.definition: A set of rules for solving a problem or completing a task.

contextSentences.en: Google's search algorithm ranks web pages using hundreds of criteria to deliver relevant results.
An efficient sorting algorithm like Quicksort can order a list in O(n log n) time.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term algorithm.

words.definition: The amount of data that can be transmitted in a given time.

contextSentences.en: Fibre optic cables can deliver a bandwidth of several gigabits per second.
Bandwidth describes how much data can be transmitted over a connection per second.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of bandwidth yesterday.
words.example_sk: Včera sme študovali pojem šírka pásma.

words.definition: A program used to access websites and online content.

contextSentences.en: Chrome, Firefox, and Safari are the most widely used browsers in the world.
A browser interprets HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to display web pages visually.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term browser.

words.definition: Temporary storage used to speed up data access.

contextSentences.en: Processors have multiple cache levels (L1, L2, L3) to speed up access to frequently used data.
When the cache is full, older entries are deleted to make room for new data.

words.example_en: The cache is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Vyrovnávacia pamäť je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: Remote online servers used to store and process data.

contextSentences.en: Cloud providers such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure dominate the global computing market.
With cloud services, applications can be scaled without having to buy physical servers.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how cloud works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje cloud.

words.definition: An organised collection of stored electronic data.

contextSentences.en: MySQL and PostgreSQL are widely used relational database management systems.
NoSQL databases like MongoDB store data in flexible document structures rather than tables.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how database works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje databáza.

words.definition: To find and remove errors in a computer program.

contextSentences.en: With a debugger, you can step through code line by line and inspect the value of every variable.
Good logging makes it much easier to debug problems that occur in a live production environment.

words.example_en: The debug is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Odladiť je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: To convert data into a coded form for security.

contextSentences.en: HTTPS uses TLS to encrypt all communication between the browser and the web server.
Quantum computers could eventually break many of the methods we currently use to encrypt data.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of encrypt yesterday.

words.definition: A security system that controls network traffic.

contextSentences.en: A firewall can be implemented in hardware or software and protects networks from unauthorised access.
By configuring the firewall, specific ports and IP addresses can be blocked.

words.example_en: The firewall is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Firewall je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: The point where systems, programs, or users interact.

contextSentences.en: REST APIs are the most widely used interface for communication between web applications.
A well-documented interface allows third parties to integrate their own applications.

words.example_en: The interface is important in this field.
words.example_sk: Rozhranie je v tejto oblasti dôležitý.

words.definition: Software designed to damage or disrupt computer systems.

contextSentences.en: Ransomware is a particularly dangerous form of malware that encrypts files and demands a ransom.
Malware often spreads through infected email attachments or insecure websites.

words.example_en: The teacher explained the term malware.

words.definition: A group of connected computers or devices.

contextSentences.en: A local area network (LAN) connects devices within a single building or campus.
The internet is the world's largest network, connecting billions of devices.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how network works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje sieť.

words.definition: The smallest unit of a digital image or display.

contextSentences.en: A 4K screen has a resolution of 3,840 × 2,160 pixels and delivers a very sharp image.
When you zoom into a digital image, the individual pixels become visible and the image looks blurry.

words.example_en: We studied the concept of pixel yesterday.

words.definition: A computer that provides services to other computers.

contextSentences.en: A web server receives HTTP requests from clients and returns the appropriate web pages.
For high availability, servers are distributed across redundant data centres around the world.

words.example_en: This experiment shows how server works.
words.example_sk: Tento experiment ukazuje, ako funguje server.

words.definition: Programs and operating systems used by a computer.

contextSentences.en: Agile software development relies on short development cycles and close collaboration with the client.
Proprietary software, unlike open-source software, cannot be freely viewed or modified.
